correctness.rationale: The quartic is the same F3 plane curve as the earlier paper after multiplication of its equation by 2 (an invertible scalar). The supplied verify_bks.py uses two irreducible field presentations for each of Q=27,81, enumerates all Q²+Q+1 canonical projective points and dual lines, exactly evaluates homogeneous quartic and complete incidences, and checks the four-secants against pair-generated lines. Complete finite enumeration is an exhaustive certificate for the two fields, unlike a sample. Independent arithmetic checks verify line-spectrum counts sum to 757 and 6643, weighted sums equal 31*28 and 79*82, and the separate on/off multiplicity counts partition the planes. The already published full census matches every table exactly. No general extension-degree claim is made.
